string-array.name: motivational_quotes
string-array.item: Small steps every day still take you across mountains.
You don’t have to be perfect, just consistent.
Progress is progress, no matter how tiny.
Your future self is already proud of you.
One done todo is better than a hundred planned ones.
Be gentle with yourself — you’re doing better than you think.
Discipline is choosing what you want most over what you want now.
Every right swipe is a quiet victory.
You are not behind. You are exactly where you need to be.
The secret is showing up, even on the hard days.
Little by little, a little becomes a lot.
Your only competition is who you were yesterday.
Rest if you must, but never quit the small things.
The only bad day is the one where you didn’t try.
